prompt: Flat 2D cartoon illustration for a children's-book-style language course. Clean uniform dark-brown outlines, flat colours with at most one soft shadow tone, simple rounded shapes, simple friendly faces with small dot eyes, warm muted palette of cream, sage green, mustard, terracotta and dusty blue. Clean, readable composition with plenty of simple everyday details drawn as plain shapes, no textures. No text, no letters, no logos, no speech bubbles, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. Wide establishing shot of an empty location, no people, framed wide enough that every item in the description is visible and none is left out. A small, cosy, lived-in kitchen in a Dutch city flat, seen from the doorway so that both side walls show. Centre and right: a large window with a white frame, three potted herbs on the sill and red-brick terraced houses across the street; directly in front of the window a small square light-wood table with exactly two wooden chairs facing each other and a bowl of apples in the middle. Left wall: a run of sage-green lower cabinets with round brass knobs under a light-wood worktop, white square wall tiles, a two-ring electric hob with a small saucepan, a stainless-steel sink with a dish rack, a bread board with half a loaf, an electric kettle and a small black coffee machine. Above the worktop one open wooden shelf with a row of mismatched mugs, plain unlabelled glass jars and a stack of plates, and below it a rail with a ladle, a whisk and a tea towel. Beside the cabinets a narrow white fridge with a few round magnets. Pale cream walls, a small round wall clock above the doorway, a light terracotta floor, warm morning light.
